tools.name: queryOntology
tools.description: Execute a SPARQL SELECT query against the cargo bike domain ontology (Apache Jena, OWL-micro inference enabled). Use this to look up class hierarchies, discover applicable properties for a concept, and verify subclass/range inferences before choosing other tools. Available prefixes: cat: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/catalog#>, cus: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/customers#>, inv: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/inventory#>, ord: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/orders#>, shp: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/shipping#>.

sparql.description: A SPARQL 1.1 SELECT query. Declare needed prefixes, e.g.: PREFIX cat: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/catalog#> PREFIX cus: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/customers#> PREFIX inv: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/inventory#> PREFIX ord: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/orders#> PREFIX shp: <https://example.com/ont/cargobike/shipping#>
